mobbin:272048bd-060c-49bf-b4ad-e37b5d2a4.summary: Before 'Enter classroom', the learner opens 'Test devices', records a short audio and video (AV) sample, answers Yes/No about seeing themselves, then returns with Camera and mic checkmarked.
steps: Device check: Camera and mic vs Network
AV test recording with say prompt
'Can you see yourself' Yes or No
steal: The device-check screen splits Camera and mic from Network and device, with tips on how to fix problems (screen 2).
A 5-second AV sample says it will not be saved or shared and starts with 'Start test' (screen 3).
During the sample the screen shows 'Recording in progress', 'Try saying…', and a progress bar (screen 5).
Yes/No asks 'Can you see yourself' with 'If not, we'll help you fix it' and 'New test', then Camera and mic get green checks (screens 6-7).
avoid: The device-check screen repeats (screens 2 and 4) with little new information, which confuses operators running a daily room self-test.
mobbin:272048bd-060c-49bf-b4ad-e37b5d2a4.fit: Recording: replaces the planned per-room self-test outside the SRV with a guided cam/mic sample, Yes/No confirm and checkmarked health summary before the session.
